text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer.
It's a fine morning.
choice_data_list: Good morning. How was your vacation?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I spent my time perusing the illustrated
rose compendium passed down from my
grandmother.
It was a tranquil and pleasant holiday.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The illustrated guide also includes
varieties
cultivated in French châteaux.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is magnificently beautiful.
I would truly love for you to behold it
someday as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rose Kingdom spoke calmly about her day
off.
It seemed she was able to get a decent amount
of rest.
